edges: Princess Petulant is the spoiled daughter of the King, who is also her uncle.
The Prime Minister volunteers his son Martin to find a special toy for Princess Petulant.
A pine dwarf promises to bring Princess Petulant to the waterfall to show her the way to Martin.
The Toymaker is pleased to see Martin and Princess Petulant and wishes they stay and play with him forever.
The Toymaker assists Martin and Princess Petulant in their journey home after they tell him they cannot stay.
Upon their return, Martin and Princess Petulant tell the entire story to a Royal Historian.
One person died due to Tropical Storm Gert.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Martin becomes distracted and engages in conversation with a fish, which traps him in the country of conversation.
Tropical Storm Gert caused significant rainfall in Tamaulipas.
Bobolink warns Martin to avoid conversation with the creatures in the country of conversation.
Tropical Storm Gert made landfall south of Tampico.
Tropical Storm Gert formed in the Bay of Campeche.
Tropical Storm Gert caused evacuations in Nuevo León.
Tropical Storm Gert caused damage in Veracruz.
1,000 people were evacuated from low-lying residences and businesses near Naranjos Amatlán due to Tropical Storm Gert.
Tropical Storm Gert caused significant rainfall in San Luis Potosí.
